systemStatus.detail:
MON AUG 24, 4:00 AM PT RUN. Sources pulled: Gmail (Toast, Sling, Google Business Profile, SpotHopper, Yelp, Google Ads, TripAdvisor) and a live Chrome read of BOTH Google Business Profiles.

1. TOAST SAT AUG 22 -- NOW FULLY CONFIRMED AND BACKFILLED. The 229 W Montecito single-location Daily Performance Summary landed at 7:39 AM PT Aug 23 and matches the group email exactly: net $16,721.45, gross $16,946.75, 181 orders, 278 guests, 190 checks. So it was NOT a rollup artifact. vs same Saturday last week: net +99.2%, but guests -8.9% and orders -11.3%. Avg check $38.68 -> $88.01 (+127.5%). Dinner did $14,066.85 net at $148.07/order; Dining Room $13,588.70 at $123.53/order; Back Room only $173, so this was not a private-room buyout. Labor was excellent at 13.3% of net ($2,228.66) vs 18.9% SDLW. Voids $259.50 across 24 items / 16 orders, up 241% vs SDLW. ACTION: pull the Aug 22 check detail and look at the top 10 checks.

2. SUNDAY AUG 23 TOAST -- NOT YET SENT. Nothing had arrived by 4:00 AM. Group lands ~6:28 AM, single-location ~7:39 AM. Yesterday's numbers are not in this brief.

3. TODAY'S SLING ROSTER -- NOT YET SENT. Sling emails the daily report ~7:00 AM PT. Latest on file is Sunday Aug 23: 11 employees, 13 shifts, 55.50 hours, 0 uncovered, 5.25 OT hours, and only ONE cook.

4. GOOGLE REVIEWS -- BOTH PROFILES CHECKED. The Brewhouse: 4.5 stars, 528 reviews (up 1 from the 527 verified Aug 23, with no notification email, so the unreplied queue may be 6 not 5). Brewhouse Coffee: 5.0 stars, 5 reviews, unchanged, 1 unreplied (Geoff Lay, 9 days). Reply-status could not be verified this run -- business.google.com redirected to the public search merchant panel, which does not expose the Unreplied tab. Unreplied list is carried forward from the Aug 23 4:05 AM live-verified run.

5. DONALD CLAY 1-STAR FOODBORNE-ILLNESS ALLEGATION -- 17 DAYS UNANSWERED. Still the single highest-risk open item. Do not post a reply without pulling the Aug 8 lunch ticket and taco temp logs first.

6. YELP: 1 consumer marketing blast, 0 actionable inquiries. Business inbox still 15 unread as of Aug 21.

7. GOOGLE ADS: 2 routine report emails, 0 disapprovals, 0 budget alerts. PMax policy block unchanged.

8. TRIPADVISOR: no ad-performance report in the last 24h.
